description: This Java source file defines a Spring repository class 'BillableHourRepository' that interacts with a database table 'billable_hours'. It provides methods for inserting new records and retrieving recent billable hour entries, utilizing JDBC template and SQL queries.

classes.name: BillableHourRepository
classes.description: Repository class managing CRUD operations for billable_hours data in the database, including insertion and retrieval of recent entries.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new billable hour record into the database and returns a DTO with enriched information.

methods.name: findRecent
methods.description: Retrieves a list of recent billable hour entries up to a specified limit.
